cohort: Parturients undergoing cesarean section for placenta previa
finding: Regional anesthesia was associated with less blood loss, lower need for blood transfusion, and better maternal and neonatal outcomes in women undergoing cesarean section for placenta previa.
mod_finding: Regional anesthesia was associated with less blood loss, lower need for blood transfusion, and better maternal and neonatal outcomes in women undergoing cesarean section for placenta previa.
